heading: •NOOOOOOOOOOOO! (V)
game_text: Cancel Broken Concentration, The Circle Is Now Complete, or a duel initiated during battle. (Immune to Young Fool.) OR During any draw phase, place a card from hand under your Used Pile to take any one card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.
game_text_lines:
Cancel Broken Concentration, The Circle Is Now
Complete, or a duel initiated during battle. (Immune to
Young Fool.) OR During any draw phase, place a card
from hand under your Used Pile to take any one card
into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle.
lore: Sometimes, the truth isn’t very pretty.
